findings.title: Mobile chat people search never finds anyone, so New Chat, New Group and Add members do not work in the Expo app.
findings.scenario: Tom opens New Chat on his phone and types 'Omar'. The list always says 'No users found', even though Omar is his own pharmacist. Tom also cannot start a group with Ali and Mia or add Ben to an existing group. On web the same actions work. If a row ever did match, the app would send Omar's membership id as a user id and could open a chat with the wrong person.
findings.test_needed: Return a participant row {id:7,user_details:{first_name:'Omar'}} from fetchChatParticipants; searchParticipants('omar') must return it, and starting a chat must send membershipId 7, not userId 7.
